title: Align task protocol and backend scaffold anchors
verify: Task schema accepts TASK-<NNN>-T<N>-FT-<NNN>-W<N>, tier, optional runtime_context, and FT-000/W0 semantics.
Backend exposes stable create_app/settings/database anchors and tests prove import/start behavior.
No product auth/session, Plant lifecycle, admin, agent, safety, photo, timeline, dataset, or PWA behavior is implemented.

verify.summary: mb-lint passed; targeted backend pytest passed with 10 tests; mb-doctor passed with 0 warnings; git diff --check passed. Existing backend scaffold anchors and current task-id schema satisfy TASK-000 without product-domain implementation.

constraints: Do not create product task records.
Do not implement product domain behavior.
Keep changes limited to task protocol compatibility and scaffold/package anchors.
invariants: W0 is reserved for FT-000 foundation tasks.
purpose: Ensure task tooling and backend scaffold anchors are unambiguous before executable Foundation work.
success_outcome: Future FT-000 and product task records can rely on one task-id format and stable backend entrypoint/settings/database anchors.
